audit.whatIsWrong: The whole entry is written in placeholders — the full layer literally calls his ultimate 'Ultimate' in eleven strings, and the content layer says 'his Q-E burst', 'his engage' and 'his gap-close' without naming anything.
audit.why: A loading-screen page that says 'track Ultimate' gives a player nothing to look for. Riot's kit names all five: Cultivation of War, The Darkin Glaive, Dreaded Return, Aureate Rush, Grim Deliverance.
audit.corrected: Real names inserted throughout, with the lane refocused onto Aureate Rush (10/9.5/9/8.5/8) as the tracked cooldown rather than an unnamed ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: His level 2 spike was attributed to a generic 'Q-E burst' with no mechanism.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive is an attack reset that slashes twice, heals him, and can be recast so his next attack knocks you up; Aureate Rush is the dash that delivers it. That pairing — dash in, glaive, recast for the knockup — is what wins him level 2, and naming it tells you what to sidestep.
audit.corrected: Level 2 spike and whys[1] now describe the Aureate Rush into Darkin Glaive recast knockup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dreaded Return and Grim Deliverance never appear, so the entry never says he can pull you back after you disengage or heal off his ultimate.
audit.why: Dreaded Return (14/13.5/13/12.5/12) stabs and then pulls enemies toward him, which is what punishes an Akali who shrouds and walks; Grim Deliverance heals for a portion of the damage it deals, which is why a burst that does not kill hands the duel back to him.
audit.corrected: Both added — the pull to the level 6 and mid text, the ultimate heal to the late text.

edits.before: His spike — you have no shroud and shallow energy, so his Q-E burst simply wins the exchange. Give ground and farm.
edits.after: His spike — no shroud, shallow energy, so Aureate Rush into a Darkin Glaive recast knockup wins it. Give ground and farm.

edits.before: Shroud plus Perfect Execution finally answer his all-in: you can dodge his engage and restart or exit fights with two dashes.
edits.after: Shroud plus Perfect Execution finally answer him: dodge Aureate Rush, 10s at rank 1, and use two dashes to restart or exit fights.

edits.before: Your AP spike lands — one full combo now out-bursts anything his bruiser build can produce. Start hunting.
edits.after: Your AP spike lands — one full combo out-bursts his bruiser build. Hunt while Dreaded Return is down, 14s.

edits.before: From the shroud pocket you delete him in any sidelane duel before his sustain gets a say.
edits.after: From the shroud pocket you delete him in a duel before Grim Deliverance's heal gets a say.

edits.before: Survive the bully phases. He spikes at 2 while you have no shroud and shallow energy — give ground, don't eat his Q-E burst for free. Level 3 evens out as your Q sustain blunts his poke, then 4-5 tilt back to him whenever your energy runs empty. Farm with Q at max range and only trade on a full bar.
edits.after: Survive the bully phases. He spikes at 2 while you have no shroud and shallow energy — give ground, don't eat Aureate Rush into a Darkin Glaive recast knockup for free. Level 3 evens as your Q sustain blunts his poke, then 4-5 tilt back to him whenever your energy runs empty. Farm at max Q range and only trade on a full bar.

edits.before: Level 6 is where the lane turns honest: shroud dodges his gap-close and Perfect Execution gives you two dashes to restart or exit fights. At first item you're ahead outright — your AP combo out-bursts his bruiser build, so start forcing shroud fights and look for the one-combo kill whenever his engage is down.
edits.after: Level 6 turns the lane honest: shroud dodges Aureate Rush and Perfect Execution gives you two dashes to restart or exit. Don't walk out lazily — Dreaded Return, 14s, stabs and pulls you back in. At first item you're ahead outright: your AP combo out-bursts his bruiser build, so force shroud fights whenever his rush is down.

edits.before: Two-plus items, you delete him from the shroud pocket in any sidelane duel — but only on your setup. Enter on your terms, hold the second R dash as the finisher or the exit, and never mud-wrestle him with shroud down. In teamfights, shroud flanks onto his backline are worth more than dueling the bruiser.
edits.after: Two-plus items, you delete him from the shroud pocket in any sidelane duel — but only on your setup. Enter on your terms, hold the second R dash as the finisher or the exit, and never mud-wrestle a man whose Grim Deliverance heals off its own damage. In teamfights, shroud flanks beat dueling the bruiser.

notes: This entry was almost entirely placeholder text: the full layer used the literal word 'Ultimate' as Zaahen's ability name in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, four phases, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading, dosFull and dontsFull.
